admin_trend.user_query: How has satisfaction changed over time?
admin_trend.ai_message:
Across the six surveys, spanning 2024 to 2025, overall satisfaction has fallen 8 points — from 80% to 72%. The steepest single drop sits between Q4 2024 and Q1 2025, which is when the new online renewal portal launched.

I can only show correlation here. The portal is the obvious candidate, but nothing in these responses proves it caused the drop.
